name: UK inflation & rates
summary: UK CPI rose to 3.6% in October, a one-year high, from 3.5%; Bank Rate 4% with a December rise widely expected
state: The ONS reported on 18 Nov that CPI inflation rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September, driven by motor fuels up 33.2% on the year, inside the 2.5–4.0% Watch band (ONS). Core inflation held at 2.8% and services at 3.7%, and markets put the chance of a December rate rise at about 80% (RTÉ). The Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov and expects inflation to peak near 5% next summer (AP).
for_you: Rising prices squeeze household budgets, especially for drivers and heating. Borrowers on variable or expiring fixed-rate mortgages are most exposed to further Bank Rate rises.
rubric_hit: Watch: ONS CPI 3.6% within 2.5–4.0% band; below 4.0% Alert line, no emergency BoE move
